arxiv-2104-07527.title: The KAGRA underground environment and lessons for the Einstein Telescope
arxiv-2104-07527.creator: Takaaki Yokozawa
arxiv-2104-07527.description: Abstract The KAGRA gravitational-wave detector in Japan is the only operating detector hosted in an underground infrastructure. Underground sites promise a greatly reduced contribution of the environment to detector noise thereby opening the possibility to extend the observation band to frequencies well below 10 Hz.

arxiv-2109-03258.title: Lorentz Violation in the Matter–Gravity Sector
arxiv-2109-03258.creator: Zonghao Li
arxiv-2109-03258.description: Abstract We construct the general Lorentz-violating effective field theory in curved spacetime and the corresponding nonrelativistic Hamiltonian in the Earth’s gravitational field. Applying this general framework to three types of experiments, free-dropping, interferometer, and bound-state experiments, we extract first constraints on certain new coefficients in the matter–gravity sector.

arxiv-2411-14641.title: MAGAZ3NE: Evidence for Galactic Conformity in z ≳ 3 z\gtrsim 3 Protoclusters
arxiv-2411-14641.creator: Ian McConachie, Gillian Wilson, Ben Forrest, Z. Cemile Marsan, Adam Muzzin, M. C. Cooper, Marianna Annunziatella, Danilo Marchesini, Percy Gomez, Wenjun Chang, Stephanie M. arxiv-2411-14641.description: Abstract We examine the quiescent fractions of massive galaxies in six z ≳ 3 z\gtrsim 3 spectroscopically-confirmed protoclusters in the COSMOS field, one of which is newly confirmed and presented here. We report the spectroscopic confirmation of MAGAZ3NE J100143+023021 at z = 3.122 − 0.004 + 0.007 z=3.122^{+0.007}_{-0.

arxiv-2504-11498.title: Matrix representation and GPU-optimized parallel B-spline computing
arxiv-2504-11498.creator: Jiayu Wu, Qiang Zou
arxiv-2504-11498.description: Abstract B-spline modeling is fundamental to CAD systems, and its evaluation and manipulation algorithms currently in use were developed decades ago, specifically for CPU architectures. While remaining effective for many applications, these algorithms become increasingly inadequate as CAD models grow more complex, such as large-scale assemblies and microstructures.

arxiv-2507-04741.title: Vision-Language Models Can’t See the Obvious
arxiv-2507-04741.creator: Yasser Dahou Ngoc Dung Huynh Phuc H. Le-Khac
arxiv-2507-04741.description: Abstract We present Saliency Benchmark (SalBench), a novel benchmark designed to assess the capability of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLM) in detecting visually salient features that are readily apparent to humans, such as a large circle amidst a grid of smaller ones. This benchmark focuses on low-level features including color, intensity, and orientation, which are fundamental to human visual processing.

britannica-1911-niobe.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-niobe.description: Article 'Niobe' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 19), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. wife of Amphion, king of Thebes. Proud of her numerous family, six daughters and six sons, she boasted of her superiority to her friend Leto, the mother of only two children, Apollo and Artemis. As a punishment, Apollo slew her sons and Artemis her daughters. Their bodies lay for nine days unburied, for Zeus had changed the people to stones; on the tenth day they were buried by the gods.

pmc-11692857.title: CONTROL AT EVERY AGE: HOW EMOTIONAL RESPONSES VARY ACROSS LIFESPAN
pmc-11692857.creator: Ryan Muskin, David Popivker, Eric Allard
pmc-11692857.description: Control may play a crucial role in regulating emotional reactivity, with this regulation potentially differing between older and younger adults across various emotional subtypes. Research suggests that perceptions of control tend to decrease with age, which may result in older adults being more sensitive to low-control situations.

pmc-12372284.title: A review on multi-omics integration for aiding study design of large scale TCGA cancer datasets
pmc-12372284.creator: Eonyong Han, Hwijun Kwon, Inuk Jung
pmc-12372284.description: BackgroundRapid advancements in high-throughput sequencing technologies allow for detailed and accurate measurement of omics features within their biological context. The integration of different omics types creates heterogeneous datasets, presenting challenges in analysis due to variations in measurement units, sample numbers, and features.

pmc-12444802.title: Nasal Myiasis in an Immunocompetent Child With Cerebral Palsy: A Case Report
pmc-12444802.creator: Mohamed Bouallou, Mohammed Amine Rabhi, Achraf Sbai, Drissia Benfadil, Azzedine Lachkar, Fahd El Ayoubi
pmc-12444802.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Myiasis is a parasitic infestation, either accidental or obligatory, that affects animals and humans and is caused by the larvae of flies, also known as maggots. Nasal myiasis is more commonly encountered in tropical and subtropical regions.

pmc-12610139.title: Enhancing the Postharvest Stability of Hass Avocado Through Vacuum Impregnation with Antioxidants
pmc-12610139.creator: Tania María Guzmán-Armenteros, Armando Echeverría, Jenny Ruales, Maritza Ruiz-Medina, Luis Ramos-Guerrero, Marc Regier
pmc-12610139.description: This study assessed the effect of vacuum impregnation with antioxidants on the postharvest quality of Hass avocados. Fruits were treated with 1% calcium lactate + 1% ascorbic acid (T1) or 1% calcium lactate + 1% citric acid (T2), under 1 bar for 30 s, and compared with untreated controls.

pmc-12627058.title: Aberrant regional homogeneity in multiple frequency bands in patients with alcohol use disorder
pmc-12627058.creator: Xia Ruan, Tingting Yu, Cixing You, Ming Yang, Jun Chen
pmc-12627058.description: BackgroundIt is unclear whether the alterations in neural oscillations in patients with alcohol use disorder (AUD) are specific to different frequency bands. We applied the regional homogeneity (ReHo) approach to examine intrinsic functional connectivity variations in various frequency bands in AUD patients.MethodsThirty-three AUD patients and 29 healthy controls (HCs) were enrolled in this study.

pmc-12630036.title: Flow-driven construction of capillary-scale vessels with predefined geometries in natural hydrogels
pmc-12630036.creator: Akira Ono, Ryohei Ouchi, Yusei Kumagai, Masahiko Suda, Tadahiro Yamashita, Yoshihiro Taguchi, Ryo Sudo
pmc-12630036.description: Forming capillary networks with predefined geometries is a critical challenge in engineering complex three-dimensional tissues in vitro. While bioprinting and microfluidic technologies have enabled vascular tissue fabrication, precise control over capillary-scale vascularization remains limited. In this study, we investigated vascular formation process along hydrogel microchannels to elucidate mechanisms governing capillary-scale lumen formation.

pmc-13275012.title: DeepPTMPred: a multi-modal deep learning framework for accurate prediction of protein post-translational modification sites
pmc-13275012.creator: Chenkui Wang, Qianhui Jiang, Dan Yu, Jiahui Guan, Zimeng Chen, Xiaoling Lu, Bin Yan, Jing Qin, Yong Liu, Junwen Wang
pmc-13275012.description: Post-translational modifications are important for regulating cellular functions. Although traditional experimental methods accurately identify PTM sites, they are time-consuming. In this study, we propose a novel model capable of predicting 17 types of PTMs through multi-modal integration and AlphaFold predictions.

pmc-13573792.title: Intermittent Hypoxia-Induced Inflammation and the Formation of Exhaled Volatile Organic Compound Profiles in Obstructive Sleep Apnea-Hypopnea Syndrome: A Narrative Review
pmc-13573792.creator: Yang Wang, Lei Pan
pmc-13573792.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Obstructive sleep apnea-hypopnea syndrome (OSAHS) is characterized by recurrent upper airway obstruction during sleep, intermittent hypoxia (IH), and sleep fragmentation, and is associated with oxidative stress, chronic low-grade inflammation, metabolic dysregulation, and upper airway remodeling. These pathophysiological disturbances may alter the generation and release of volatile metabolites, thereby providing a rationale for investigating exhaled volatile organic compound (VOC) profiles as noninvasive indicators of OSAHS-related redox imbalance, inflammatory activity, and metabolic abnormalities.
